1.consolidated_definition: Dominarlo, pararle el carro. “Jay que parále las patas, pos el otro día también me vino con chanzas.” Meléndez Muñoz, , p. 98.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To dominate someone, to put them in their place. "Make him keep his feet on the ground, for he came at me with jokes just the other day as well." Meléndez Muñoz, p. 98.
